chunks.query: Generate an ordered list of every distinct step performed in this video, in order. Include brief steps and steps that are repeated. Write each step as a direct, actionable instruction, as if telling the reader what to do. Do not narrate or describe what is happening in the video. Capture the details needed to repeat the action exactly: control and part names, printed and on-screen text quoted word for word, part numbers, model and serial numbers, tool types and sizes, quantities, and which way things move. For every component being handled, state where it is using grid terms such as top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, center-left, or upper-center. Where several similar actions are performed, such as four screws on one panel, treat each as its own step and say what distinguishes it. Where the video shows how to tell the step worked, say that. Base every step on what is visible; use the spoken narration where there is any, and rely on the picture alone where the video is silent. Each step must describe a different action from the one before it — where two moments look alike, state what changed between them. Do not invent steps, parts, or details that are not shown or stated in the video.

rows.instruction: Stop the car safely on a firm level surface, away from traffic if possible.
Set up a warning triangle and turn on the hazard lights.
Switch off the ignition and ensure that all passengers safely exit the vehicle.
Retrieve the spare wheel and replacement tools from the trunk.
Use the tool provided to remove the hubcap.
Use the wrench to loosen the nuts one half to one turn.
Loosen the nuts further by hand or by using your foot.
Search the underside of the vehicle to find the jacking point closest to the wheel you want to replace.
Never put any object or any part of your body under the vehicle when using the jack.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire easily clears the road.

rows.instruction: Position the jack under the vehicle's designated jacking point.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire clears the ground.
Remove all the wheel nuts and the flat tire.
Avoid touching the disc wheels or the area around the brakes.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub and align the holes.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground, then tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence using the wrench.
Lower the car completely, remove the jack, and store the tools in their proper place.
Place the flat tire somewhere handy to have it fixed and replaced by a Toyota repairer.
Check the wheel nuts after a couple of hundred kilometers of driving to ensure they are still tight.
Observe the speed limit of 80 km/h when driving with a compact spare wheel.
